description: Search the Society’s Journal, longer articles for patients and practitioners, by keywords and/or topic. Returns matching articles with title, date, summary, key points and URL; read one in full with get_article. For a short factual answer use answer_question instead.

limit.description: How many articles to return (default 5, max 20).

query.description: Keywords to match in titles and text, e.g. "grass pollen trial".

topic.description: Optional topic: For patients, Evidence, Cost, For practitioners or Society news.

name: search_journal
title: Search the Journal
